name: Youth Empowerment Services (YES), WIOA Youth Program
city: Concord, CA (serves Central Contra Costa County and Bay Point)
what_you_do: You get a case manager who helps you finish school, plan for college or a career, and find work. Help includes tutoring, job training, mentors, and paid and unpaid work experience.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 16 to 24 who live in Central Contra Costa County or Bay Point. You must be able to work in the U.S. and show proof of low income. Priority goes to McKinney-Vento (HOPE) youth, foster youth, and justice-involved youth in Bay Point and on the Monument Corridor. Being pregnant or parenting, an English learner, or having an IEP or 504 plan can also help you qualify.
pay_detail: The page lists paid and unpaid work experience. Pay is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No deadline is stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Refer a Youth form on the program page. A coordinator then works with you. Questions: Anna Ramos, 925-685-1011, extension 62028.
notes: The Workforce Development Board of Contra Costa County funds and supports this WIOA grant. For East or West Contra Costa County, the page points to the County Office of Education. The page lists 14 required program elements, including leadership development and financial literacy education.
